mapper.select: SELECT id AS alertId, payment_id AS paymentId, order_id AS orderId, SUBSTRING_INDEX(message, ' ', 1) AS completionStep FROM payment_alert_log WHERE alert_type = 'PAYMENT_COMPLETION_FAILED' AND message LIKE 'POINT_EARN %' AND id > #{lastId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE))) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{chunkSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='PROCESSING', updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id = #{alertId} AND (status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(6), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE)))
mapper.select: SELECT o.member_id AS memberId, p.amount AS amount, p.used_point_amount AS usedPointAmount FROM payment p JOIN orders o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.id = #{paymentId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM point_ledger WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND type = #{type})
SELECT balance FROM point_balance WHERE member_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE point_balance SET balance = #{balance}, updated_at = NOW(6) WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_ledger (member_id, order_id, type, amount, balance_after, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{orderId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, NOW(6), NOW(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='RESOLVED', resolved_at=NOW(6), updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId}
UPDATE payment_alert_log SET status='FAILED', retry_count=retry_count+1, updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{alertId}
